decision_notes: Qualifying provincial legislature; exact institutional Wikidata item corroborated by its country, legislative type and jurisdiction claims plus primary institutional pages.

Proceedings: The assembly homepage explicitly labels @asambleadepartamental-comu59/streams as its live-session destination. Ordinary sittings labelled 22 and 21 October 2026 were checked at forty minutes, beyond introductory tourism material, and show substantive 2027 legal and education budget presentations with regional institutional branding. Finance and planning committee recordings also appear in the provider index but were not individually playback-certified. Current live and full room coverage remain unresolved.

Publication posture: Public institutional pages explicitly designate the viewing service. No independent audiovisual reuse grant was established. Retain an official viewing link with permission pending; no embedded player, direct-manifest redistribution or IPTV addition. Reviewed institution/footer notices and, for the Colombian assemblies, their policy page and linked Mi Colombia Digital operator terms. Those platform terms govern government site provision and do not grant this project media reuse rights. No source-specific prior-linking condition was found in the reviewed material; this is not a complete legal certification.
Promoted as an official link-out; parent-country search, regional flag and map geometry reconciled. Recording index is planned schedule metadata, not an implemented XMLTV parser.
